versions.changelog:
job-search-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release focused on Serbia & remote job search.
- Searches LinkedIn, Infostud, and HelloWorld.rs for matches to user-specified roles.
- Scores each job against your resume on a 1–10 scale with justification, outputs results in chat.
- Optional daily search scheduling and email digest via config settings.
- Generates human-tailored cover letters on demand, following strict voice rules.
- Never auto-applies or sends application materials; user control on all outputs.
